nodes.description: EIP1967 storage slot (keccak256('eip1967.proxy.implementation')-1) holding the delegatecall target address of the proxy.
EIP1967 storage slot (keccak256('eip1967.proxy.admin')-1) holding the admin address that gates upgradeTo/changeAdmin.
Proxy._delegate(address implementation): inline assembly that calldatacopy's msg.data and delegatecalls the implementation with full remaining gas.
Proxy._fallback(): calls _beforeFallback() and then _delegate(_implementation()); the central dispatch path for all unmatched calldata.
fallback() payable external: entry point for non-empty calldata that matches no selector, forwards to _fallback().
receive() payable external: entry point for empty calldata, forwards to _fallback().
Proxy._beforeFallback(): virtual hook executed before delegating; base implementation is empty.
Proxy._implementation(): abstract virtual view returning the address that the fallback should delegate to.
UpgradeableProxy constructor(address _logic, bytes _data): asserts the implementation slot constant, calls _setImplementation(_logic) and delegatecalls _data into _logic.
UpgradeableProxy._implementation(): reads the EIP1967 implementation slot via sload and returns the stored address.
UpgradeableProxy._upgradeTo(address newImplementation): stores the new implementation and emits Upgraded.
UpgradeableProxy._setImplementation(address newImplementation): private; requires Address.isContract and writes the implementation slot with sstore.
TransparentUpgradeableProxy constructor(address _logic, address _admin, bytes _data): asserts the admin slot constant, delegates to UpgradeableProxy and calls _setAdmin(_admin).
admin() external ifAdmin returns the current admin address.
implementation() external ifAdmin returns the current implementation address.
changeAdmin(address newAdmin) external ifAdmin: guards against the zero address, emits AdminChanged and calls _setAdmin(newAdmin).
upgradeTo(address newImplementation) external ifAdmin: admin-only call that delegates to _upgradeTo.
upgradeToAndCall(address newImplementation, bytes data) external payable ifAdmin: upgrades then delegatecalls caller-supplied data into the new implementation.
TransparentUpgradeableProxy._admin(): internal view that loads the EIP1967 admin slot via sload.
TransparentUpgradeableProxy._setAdmin(address newAdmin): private; writes the admin slot with sstore.
TransparentUpgradeableProxy._beforeFallback(): requires msg.sender != _admin() so the admin can never reach the proxy fallback (transparent proxy protection).
Delegator constructor(address _logic, bytes _data): passes msg.sender of the deployer as the admin to TransparentUpgradeableProxy.
delegateAdmin() external view: publicly exposes _admin() with no access restriction.
delegateImplementation() external view: publicly exposes _implementation() with no access restriction.
Delegator._beforeFallback() internal override: empty body, does NOT call super and drops the admin-cannot-fallback protection.
msg.sender used inside the Delegator constructor; it becomes the initial admin of the proxy.
msg.sender used by the ifAdmin modifier and by _beforeFallback guards to decide between admin functions and fallback delegation.
delegatecall(gas(), implementation, 0, calldatasize(), 0, 0) inside Proxy._delegate: executes arbitrary code in the proxy storage context.
newImplementation.delegatecall(data) inside the external payable upgradeToAndCall path.
sstore(slot, newImplementation) writing the EIP1967 implementation slot inside _setImplementation.
sstore(slot, newAdmin) writing the EIP1967 admin slot inside _setAdmin.
Address.isContract(address account): extcodesize check used to validate the new implementation address before it is stored.
target.call{value: weiValue}(data) low-level call inside Address._functionCallWithValue, forwarding ETH to an arbitrary target.
Address._functionCallWithValue(address target, bytes data, uint256 weiValue, string errorMessage): validates isContract and bubbles revert data.
_logic.delegatecall(_data) inside the UpgradeableProxy constructor used to initialize proxied storage.
Parameter `implementation` of Proxy._delegate: address that receives the delegatecall.
Parameter `_logic` of the UpgradeableProxy constructor: initial implementation address.
Parameter `_data` of the UpgradeableProxy constructor: calldata delegatecalled to _logic during initialization.
Parameter `newImplementation` of _upgradeTo/_setImplementation/upgradeTo: the address written into the implementation slot.
Parameter `newAdmin` of changeAdmin/_setAdmin: the address written into the admin slot.
Parameter `data` of upgradeToAndCall: caller-supplied calldata that is delegatecalled into the new implementation.
Local `slot` in UpgradeableProxy._implementation holding _IMPLEMENTATION_SLOT before sload.
Local `impl` returned by UpgradeableProxy._implementation after the assembly sload.
Local `success` in the UpgradeableProxy constructor capturing the result of the initializing delegatecall.
Parameter `account` of Address.isContract, checked with extcodesize.

edges.reason: msg.sender of the deployer flows into the Delegator constructor and is used as the proxy admin.
Delegator constructor forwards msg.sender to the TransparentUpgradeableProxy constructor as the _admin argument.
TransparentUpgradeableProxy constructor calls _setAdmin(_admin) to persist the initial privileged admin.
TransparentUpgradeableProxy constructor invokes the UpgradeableProxy constructor.
UpgradeableProxy constructor calls _setImplementation(_logic), writing the implementation slot during deployment.
UpgradeableProxy constructor reaches the delegatecall of _data into _logic for storage initialization.
fallback() forwards unmatched calldata to _fallback().
receive() forwards empty calldata to _fallback().
_fallback() invokes the virtual _beforeFallback hook.
Virtual dispatch inside _fallback() resolves the hook to Delegator._beforeFallback, whose empty body applies no admin guard.
Delegator._beforeFallback overrides the base hook without calling super, removing the require(msg.sender != _admin()) protection.
_fallback() calls _delegate(_implementation()) to hand over execution.
msg.sender is compared against _admin() in the base _beforeFallback admin guard.
Because Delegator._beforeFallback ignores msg.sender, an admin-originated call is not blocked and reaches the proxy fallback, enabling selector clashing between admin and implementation functions.
_delegate executes the inline-assembly delegatecall operation.
The implementation parameter is the address _delegate uses as delegatecall target.
The implementation address flows into the delegatecall selector inside the assembly block.
UpgradeableProxy._implementation overrides the abstract Proxy._implementation.
_implementation reads the EIP1967 implementation slot via sload.
_upgradeTo calls _setImplementation(newImplementation).
external upgradeTo is gated by the ifAdmin modifier and then invokes the internal _upgradeTo.
The caller-supplied newImplementation argument is the privileged value passed into the admin-only upgrade entry point.
_setImplementation validates the new implementation with Address.isContract.
_setImplementation reaches the sstore of the implementation slot.
The caller-supplied implementation address is written into the privileged storage slot through sstore.
_setImplementation overwrites the _IMPLEMENTATION_SLOT state variable.
upgradeToAndCall reaches the delegatecall of the caller data into the new implementation.
The externally supplied data parameter is the payload of the delegatecall.
changeAdmin calls _setAdmin(newAdmin) after the ifAdmin gate.
newAdmin is caller-controlled and flows into the admin-only changeAdmin entry point.
newAdmin is written into the admin slot by the sstore operation.
sstore overwrites the _ADMIN_SLOT state variable, transferring all admin privileges.
_setAdmin writes the EIP1967 admin slot.
_admin loads the admin address from the admin slot.
admin() returns the value produced by _admin().
implementation() returns the value produced by _implementation().
delegateAdmin publicly exposes the internal _admin() accessor without any access control.
delegateImplementation publicly exposes the internal _implementation() accessor without any access control.
The ifAdmin modifier compares msg.sender with _admin() before allowing admin() to return privileged data.
The ifAdmin modifier compares msg.sender with _admin() before allowing upgradeTo.
The ifAdmin modifier compares msg.sender with _admin() before allowing upgradeToAndCall.
_functionCallWithValue executes the low-level value-transferring call.
The account parameter is measured with extcodesize in isContract.
The boolean result of isContract gates whether _setImplementation may store the new implementation.
The delegatecall in _delegate forwards all remaining gas to the implementation contract, which can call back into the proxy fallback before the caller finishes.
The delegatecall performed by upgradeToAndCall hands execution to the newly installed implementation, which can re-enter the proxy's admin functions while state is still being modified.

normalization_plan.reason: The implementation parameter exists only to feed Proxy._delegate and should be normalised into that function node.
The _logic constructor argument is scoped to the UpgradeableProxy constructor and should be normalised into it.
The _data argument is used solely as the payload of the constructor delegatecall operation.
The newImplementation argument is consumed by the implementation-slot write path and should be normalised into _setImplementation.
The newAdmin argument terminates in the sstore that writes the admin slot.
The data argument is only used as the delegatecall payload in upgradeToAndCall.
The slot local is a temporary alias for _IMPLEMENTATION_SLOT inside _implementation.
The impl local is the return value of the assembly sload in _implementation.
The success local only records the outcome of the constructor's initializing delegatecall.
The account parameter is the sole input of the isContract extcodesize check.
